column1: # Sentence assignments for the recognition manuscript
# key<TAB>status<TAB>decls<TAB>note.  The key is the first twelve hex digits
# of the sha256 of the normalized sentence, printed by
# metadata/MF_RECOGNITION_SENTENCE_CENSUS.tsv, which is its join with the
# extraction.  A sentence whose wording changes loses its key and reappears
# as unassigned; that is intended, because a reworded sentence is one whose
# assignment has to be re-checked.  (This already happened once during
# assembly: the manuscript was rewritten in commits 4d8c18397/e2c11ae53/
# 6ca59f2d1 after the first key list was drawn, dropping 52 sentences and
# adding 43 new ones; this file is keyed against the tex as of that rewrite.)
# Assembled 2026-08-26 by the census-triage lane from per-section lane key
# tensor-sync, rf-compiler, prelim, branches-endpoint, hnn-permanence) plus
# the triage lane's own direct classification of non-mathematical sentences
# problems).  All 245 sentences of the manuscript are covered; every named
# declaration was checked to exist in GroupApproximation/ (see the
# companion decl-check report) but statement-level 1:1 correctness is each
# lane's own responsibility, the same as for the non-MF map.
